RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your claim for the brain MRI. I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file." 

You have the right to appeal this decision. According to our policy, you may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. Your ordering provider, Dr. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

To assist you with the appeal process, I am providing you with the exact deadline date for your appeal. The denial notice for claim CLM-550193 was sent on September 5, 2026. Therefore, the 180-day appeal window will close on March 4, 2027.

If you would like to proceed with the appeal, please let me know, and I will provide you with the necessary appeal form (FORM-APP-1). You can also contact our customer service department, and we will be happy to guide you through the process.

Please feel free to reach out to me if you have any further questions or concerns.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
